matrix.rootCause: syncCloudStatusFromElectron downgraded renderer connected=true whenever Main getCloudStatus returned connected=false on transient reads, clearing OAuth session mid-bootstrap.
matrix.divergence: Google gate recomputed false → coordinator jumped backward to google step
matrix.minimalFix: Only downgrade on authoritative auth loss (needsReauth/oauth false); preserve connected on reconcile errors.
matrix.regressionRisk: LOW — explicit user disconnect path unchanged

matrix.rootCause: setStatusFromErr attached discovery/license errors to current wizard step (often google) despite hasGoogle() true.
matrix.minimalFix: Route discovery-class errors to discovery checklist row when Google remains connected.

matrix.rootCause: branch_select populated dropdown from license.branches only; recovered license often contained placeholder BR-MAIN while discovery.branchCandidates held real branches.
matrix.minimalFix: Merge discovery branchCandidates with license branches for bootstrap branch select.

matrix.rootCause: owner step UI treated stale discovered OWNER_EXISTS as auth gate on NEW/start_new fresh path.
matrix.minimalFix: Prefer owner creation UI when isNewFreshStartPath() && !ownerCredentialCommitted().
matrix.regressionRisk: MEDIUM — guarded to NEW start_new only

matrix.rootCause: ~21% equals download_db stageRatio 0.3 with no further IPC progress during long v2SetupCloudRestore/download.
matrix.minimalFix: Heartbeat progress + operation timeout + explicit backup password prompt before native restore.

matrix.rootCause: Restore step 'إعادة فحص السحابة' button only called renderStepUI() without running discovery.
matrix.minimalFix: Invoke runDiscovery(true) to bypass cached metadata.

matrix.rootCause: BootstrapCoordinator.effectiveStepIndex snapped forward over completed steps when user navigated back (stored < resume ignored).
matrix.minimalFix: Return stored index when stored < resume.

matrix.rootCause: disconnectGoogleDuringSetup existed but UX label/obviousness insufficient; confirm added.
matrix.minimalFix: Expose 'فصل / تغيير حساب Google' with confirm dialog (reuse disconnectGoogleDuringSetup).

matrix.rootCause: Fixed grid sidebar + overflow:hidden on overlay clipped RTL content on 1366×768 / 125–150% scaling.
matrix.minimalFix: Responsive single-column checklist under 641px, calc(100vw) card width, overflow-x hidden on form host.

sharedRootCauseHypothesis.confirmed: Partial — BUG-EXT-009 transient Google downgrade could cascade to discovery/branch/path symptoms.
sharedRootCauseHypothesis.rejectedAsSoleCause: BR-MAIN and rescan no-op had independent UI bugs even when Google stayed connected.
